items.title: Jane Ira Bloom interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 3, 1998
items.q: She has performed with Billy Taylor, Charlie Haden, and Cleo Laine

ctx.x: I guess. I understood you did “Piano Jazz” with Marian McPartland?
Sure. And I interviewed with Billy Taylor. I mean I’ve been through it. You know, been through it. Ups and downs you know.
Did you ever have a point where you felt like, man this is just too hard. I can’t do this anymore.
